name: @graphrefly/native
description: GraphReFly Rust substrate (napi-rs bindings). Hand-written ergonomic ASYNC public API (`createNativeImpl()`) over the Rust GraphReFly dispatcher (Core runs on a tokio blocking pool; every Core-touching call is async). NOTE: this is NOT a sync drop-in for @graphrefly/pure-ts — @graphrefly/graphrefly consumes a sync substrate API; redirecting the peer via npm overrides will not work, and @graphrefly/graphrefly does NOT consume @graphrefly/native (Option B / D080 deferred). This package serves direct async-tolerant Node consumers. Use @graphrefly/pure-ts for @graphrefly/graphrefly today.
comment_for_humans: @graphrefly/native is the napi-rs binding for the Rust GraphReFly dispatcher. package.json mirrors the napi-rs canonical layout (binaryName + per-target sub-packages; optionalDependencies are generated by `napi prepublish` in CI, not committed). AUTH = npm OIDC trusted publishing, NO NPM_TOKEN. FIRST PUBLISH is a one-time local bootstrap: run scripts/first-publish-native.sh (interactive `npm login`; cross-builds 5 targets; publishes all 6 packages) then configure the trusted publisher on each package (graphrefly / graphrefly-rs / native-npm-publish.yml). Thereafter `native-v*` tags publish token-free via OIDC (provenance auto). publishConfig.access=public makes the scoped sub-packages public on first publish. Prereq: @graphrefly npm org + an `npm login` for the one-time bootstrap (no CI secret). This package now ships a hand-written ergonomic ASYNC public API: `import { createNativeImpl } from "@graphrefly/native"` (wrapper.js / wrapper.d.ts; Option C, D206/D207). The raw napi `Bench*` classes remain available at the `@graphrefly/native/napi` subpath. It is NOT a sync drop-in for @graphrefly/pure-ts and @graphrefly/graphrefly does NOT consume it (Option B / D080 deferred — see graphrefly-ts archive/docs/SESSION-DS-native-substrate-contract.md).
